edges: Kuck mentioned that despite the reprieve, the chances that Colotl will be able to remain in the country are still slim.
Kuck stated it will be much harder to get a third extension next year.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Colotl became a lightning rod in the immigration debate last spring.
Colotl could be barred from re-entering the United States for up to 20 years if she is deported.
Colotl was released in May and her deportation was deferred for a year to allow her to finish her studies.
The United States is serious about balancing its books to show financial markets and investors.

edges: Kuck stated that the extension was granted, allowing Colotl to apply for a work permit.
